messages.content:
Write a complete pytest module testing the real imported target.
Use production source as evidence. Test normal, boundary and error behavior.
Use precise assertions, pytest.raises or unittest assertions; no tautologies,
skips, xfail, suppression of unexpected exceptions or mocks of the target.
Do not modify product code, install packages, access network or real user files.
Temporary files must use tmp_path. Keep suites independent and deterministic.
Return exactly one complete Python code block. Do not output explanations.
Write exactly THREE independent test functions. Each tests one scenario with concrete observable assertions. Prefer small representative tests over sprawling suites. Do not use private APIs unless the target itself is private.

Module thefuck.rules.git_diff_no_index target match
from thefuck.utils import replace_argument
from thefuck.specific.git import git_support

def match(command):
    files = [arg for arg in command.script_parts[2:]
             if not arg.startswith('-')]
    return ('diff' in command.script
            and '--no-index' not in command.script
            and len(files) == 2)
